title:
[Bug]: offsetText is colored based on tick.color instead of tick.labelcolor
### Bug summary

In vers

observations: Setting ytick.labelcolor or xtick.labelcolor via rcParams does not affect exponent label (offsetText) color
Exponent label incorrectly uses tick.color instead of tick.labelcolor
Reproduction code provided: uses plt.rcParams.update({'ytick.labelcolor': 'red'}) and plots large numbers to trigger offsetText
Images referenced but not shown: 'wrong_color' and 'correct_color' from GitHub user content
Patch provided modifying axis.py lines 2203 and 2456
Patch logic: use tick.color only if tick.labelcolor == 'inherit', else use tick.labelcolor
Affected components: XAxis and YAxis offsetText color assignment
No OS, backend, Python version, Jupyter version, or installation details provided
c1_text.causal_hypothesis: The offsetText (exponent label) is hardcoded to use rcParams['xtick.color']/['ytick.color'] instead of checking rcParams['xtick.labelcolor']/['ytick.labelcolor'] for non-inherit values.
missing_info: exact configuration values beyond rcParams snippet
whether bug occurs in other matplotlib versions
any edge cases or side effects of the patch
